title: Fake Package at Dorm
scenario: A text says a parcel at reception needs a redelivery fee before collection.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Fake Package at Dorm: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Check with dorm reception or courier official tracking.
